category_title: Young adults with profound intellectual disability who communicate through non-verbal vocalizations and physical approach or withdrawal
minimal_context: John and a staff member are sitting together for a school-based social interaction activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's sit together for our social activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Engages in stereotypical hand movements while sitting.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please stop moving your hands like that.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Reaches out and attempts to grab the tutor's shirt.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: (Pulls shirt away and holds John's hands to prevent him from grabbing) No grabbing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Engages in defensive restraint, pulling against the tutor holding his hands.)

STUDENT: (Engages in defensive restraint, pulling against the tutor holding his hands.)
